description: ContextOS Research Benchmark - Synthetic Personal Knowledge Corpus

documents.content: Project Capsule initial proposal: Building an offline personal knowledge assistant. Architecture V1 utilizes React Native for mobile clients and FastAPI on local endpoints. Focus is on privacy-first document ingestion.
Architecture V2 supersedes Architecture V1. Desktop target transitioned to Tauri 2 with React and TypeScript. Ingestion switched from polling to debounced Watchdog file events.

Survey on multi-head self-attention and Transformer architectures. Discussed on September 12, 2026 during weekly AI seminar. Highlights temporal knowledge graph integration with Sentence Transformers.
Summary of Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM) and Latent Diffusion. Explains noise schedules and reverse Markov transitions for generative imaging.
